title: A space inside a code span draws about twice as wide as a monospace space
body: A `text` node in a sans font draws a code span that holds a space, such as `` `space shown` ``, with a gap about twice the width of a monospace space between the two words. `figures/space-shown.acre` shows it in bullet `b2`, rendered with `acre render --scale 2 --time 3`. The text has no `text-align justify`, so justification does not stretch the gap. A code span with no space inside, such as `` `MaskedKeys::order_ties` ``, draws as expected.
close_reason: Not a bug. A space inside a code span is one monospace space (0.6 em), as it should be; it only looks wide beside sans word gaps. Jack looked at a side-by-side render on 2026-11-24 and chose to keep true monospace spaces in inline code.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text:
I measured this before changing anything. The space inside the code span is one monospace space, and no fix in shaping, layout or font fallback applies.

- `text::layout` gives the space in `` `space shown` `` the mono font's own advance. At size 22 that is 13.2 px, the same as every other mono character (600 units to an em of 1000).
- A `text` node in the mono font gives `space shown` the same advance. In mono, `space shown` and `spaceXshown` end at the same pixel.
- At scale 2 the ink gap from the `e` to the `s` is 34 px in three places. These are bullet `b2` of `figures/space-shown.acre`, a sans `text` holding `` `space shown` ``, and a mono `text` holding `space shown`.

A sans space at size 22 is 5.72 px. The gap in the code span is about 2.3 sans spaces wide. The "twice" in the title is most likely twice the sans word gaps around the span, not twice a monospace space.

Narrowing it is a design choice for Jack. One option sets a space inside a code span at the sans space's width. Another sets it at a share of the mono cell. `wrap` already finds those spaces through its `code` mask, so either is a few lines in `text.rs`. Either one ends column alignment inside inline code. I made no change and unclaimed the issue.
